title: Part
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees in all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. This sketch consists of two loops. In the first loop, draw an arc starting at coordinates (0.0, 0.0006), with a midpoint at (0.0002, 0.0002), and ending at (0.0006, 0.0). Follow this with a line from (0.0006, 0.0) to (0.0287, 0.0), then another arc from (0.0287, 0.0) to (0.0292, 0.0006), and continue with a line from (0.0292, 0.0006) to (0.0292, 0.0143). Draw an arc from (0.0292, 0.0143) to (0.0287, 0.0149), followed by a line from (0.0287, 0.0149) to (0.0006, 0.0149), and another arc from (0.0006, 0.0149) to (0.0, 0.0143). Finally, complete the loop with a line from (0.0, 0.0143) back to (0.0, 0.0006). For the second loop, start with an arc from (0.0013, 0.0019) to (0.0019, 0.0013), then a line from (0.0019, 0.0013) to (0.0273, 0.0013), followed by an arc from (0.0273, 0.0013) to (0.0279, 0.0019), and a line from (0.0279, 0.0019) to (0.0279, 0.013). Draw an arc from (0.0279, 0.013) to (0.0273, 0.0136), then a line from (0.0273, 0.0136) to (0.0019, 0.0136), and another arc from (0.0019, 0.0136) to (0.0013, 0.013). Complete the loop with a line from (0.0013, 0.013) back to (0.0013, 0.0019). Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.0292. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using Euler angles of zero degrees and translating it with a vector of zero. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Finally, integrate the current part with the previous body by creating a new solid body. The final dimensions of the part are a length of 0.029239766081871343, a width of 0.014912280701754384, and a height of 0.7499999999999999.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the outer loop of the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0006) \
     .threePointArc((0.0002, 0.0002), (0.0006, 0.0)) \
     .lineTo(0.0287, 0.0) \
     .threePointArc((0.0291, 0.0002), (0.0292, 0.0006)) \
     .lineTo(0.0292, 0.0143) \
     .threePointArc((0.0291, 0.0147), (0.0287, 0.0149)) \
     .lineTo(0.0006, 0.0149) \
     .threePointArc((0.0002, 0.0147), (0.0, 0.0143)) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0006) \
     .close()

# Define the inner loop of the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0013, 0.0019) \
     .threePointArc((0.0015, 0.0015), (0.0019, 0.0013)) \
     .lineTo(0.0273, 0.0013) \
     .threePointArc((0.0278, 0.0015), (0.0279, 0.0019)) \
     .lineTo(0.0279, 0.013) \
     .threePointArc((0.0278, 0.0134), (0.0273, 0.0136)) \
     .lineTo(0.0019, 0.0136) \
     .threePointArc((0.0015, 0.0134), (0.0013, 0.013)) \
     .lineTo(0.0013, 0.0019) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)
